symptom: Pricing and Portal parity were present on main while production still served an older commit.
root_cause: The canonical Production Source Snapshot only triggers when its workflow file changes; the parity/i18n repair moved main without an exact-source production trigger.
prevention: After material pricing or Portal parity changes, trigger the canonical exact-source production snapshot in the same delivery lineage.
Require exact main SHA, ready Netlify production deploy, pricing production content proof, interaction proof and Production Release Readback before terminal LIVE.
Do not treat a ready older production deploy as proof for current main.
problem: Pricing and Portal parity can be merged to main without the exact current source being promoted because Production Source Snapshot is intentionally path-gated.

evidence.outcome: The canonical exact-source production promotion is triggered and must prove current-main deployment plus production pricing/readback before terminal LIVE.
